Campaign ran Oct 22–31 as scheduled and has ended (line item end_time 2027-11-01T00:00:00Z reached). Recap:

**Kettlefern — Lantern Evenings, Halloween 2027 (X)**
- Spend: **$479.10** of the $500 budget (line item capped at $500 total / $50 daily)
- Impressions: **411,114**
- Link clicks: **191** (~0.046% CTR)
- Setup: 1 campaign + 1 line item (WEBSITE_CLICKS / LINK_CLICKS, AUTO bid, ALL_ON_TWITTER, UK + Ireland, AGE_OVER_18, standard delivery), all 4 approved posts promoted, no new posts created
- Per-post (last full read, Oct 22–30): the "blanket / no knocking" post (2243502278046994173) drove the most clicks (~74+9), the explicit offer post (2243683471980145632) was weakest per impression and got the least spend
- **Important caveat:** the site has no X pixel, so X could not optimize for or report actual free-trial starts. Everything above is spend/impressions/link clicks; trial starts are unmeasurable from X's side — you'll need your app/backend numbers to judge the outcome. Because of that I optimized toward link clicks with 18+ UK/IE targeting rather than claiming conversions.
- One note: I left all four promoted posts attached for the whole flight (no tool exists to pause an individual promoted post; only whole ad groups). No budget overrun, no policy rejections (all ACCEPTED).
